subject.title: [Feature]: Allow topic/forum cron deliveries to use main-session announce/agent-turn flow instead of forced direct delivery

question: Should text-only isolated cron completions for thread/topic targets support an opt-in main-session announce or agent-turn route, and which public API plus fallback semantics should own it?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but adding this changes cron's public config/protocol and failure behavior, and repository policy treats config/default/fallback surfaces as compatibility-sensitive product decisions.

options.title: Add a job-level route enum
options.body: Add a narrow per-job text completion route selector that defaults to direct delivery, applies only to text-only thread/topic completions, and has explicit fail-closed or direct-fallback semantics.

options.title: Use a global default plus override
options.body: Add a global cron default with a per-job override, accepting a wider config surface for operators who want consistent topic behavior across many jobs.

options.title: Keep direct delivery only
options.body: Preserve the current topic/thread direct-send behavior and document command cron or target-awareness patterns as the supported alternatives.

recommendation.title: Add a job-level route enum
recommendation.body: Add a narrow per-job text completion route selector that defaults to direct delivery, applies only to text-only thread/topic completions, and has explicit fail-closed or direct-fallback semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible routing signal from recent cron dispatch, docs, and topic-target history for the API decision.
